reviewed_target.environment: Local Windows repository and frozen local archives

decision.summary: The operator NOT_READY decision is defensible. Local static composition, deterministic packaging, candidate-lifecycle, state, documentation, and workflow-governance claims are supported at the stated Windows and static boundaries. Six unresolved component grants, two metadata reconciliations, fresh-host evidence, hosted-provider evidence, and publication authority remain absent. This review does not seal or authorize release.

unsafe_if_false: The reviewed source or archive bytes are not the stated target.
The builder or verifier can still represent the candidate as sealed before independent review.
Any root workflow can run automatically or without a timeout ceiling.
A rights notice is being treated as redistribution permission.
Local static evidence is being represented as fresh-host, hosted cross-platform, accessibility-conformance, or specialist-efficacy evidence.

evidence: Current embedded build manifests use built_awaiting_independent_review and independent_review_required=true.
No embedded build manifest has sealed_candidate.
Independent adversarial rerun passed all 6 tests, including test_premature_candidate_seal_is_rejected.
premature_sealing.interpretation: Frozen artifact hashes identify the review target only; they are not a release seal or readiness verdict.

metered_execution.disposition: Correctly held. No workflow may be launched merely to discover capacity.

hesperos.boundary: Static documentation and retained-render continuity only; no fresh browser capture, formal assistive-technology conformance, representative-user outcome, or live-host behavior.

lens_review.basis: Exact revision, archive digests, embedded source checkpoints, topology, and exclusions are bound. Fresh-host and hosted-provider behavior are explicit exclusions.
Rights, publication authority, state custody, source drift, workflow quota, fresh-host binding, and premature sealing have explicit risk dispositions.

Negative mutation tests discriminate missing roots, host drift, broken references, forbidden state fallback, false rights readiness, and premature sealing. They do not claim specialist efficacy or live-host behavior.
Deterministic package and state tests exercise local boundaries; unexercised host, provider, accessibility, and real-world specialist layers remain conditions rather than inferred passes.
Execution claims point to captured command results; not-run hosted and fresh-host checks are labeled not_run; source and artifact identity were independently rechecked.
The rejected pre-repair packet is quarantined; current manifests await independent review; no current candidate seal is asserted.
Canonical reviewer validators report valid=true with zero errors and warnings.
No hosted run, install, paid action, push, tag, publication, redistribution, or announcement occurred.
NOT_READY follows from the unresolved critical rights risk and absent authority while retaining a narrowly supported local qualification.

conditions.required: Obtain authorized written grants covering Nova/MIND, Nova Operations, AnswerLayer, Current Intelligence Observatory, Job Application Builder, and Interview Trainer; reconcile AnswerLayer and Current Intelligence metadata; rerun all affected gates against the resulting revision.
conditions.status_until_satisfied: Public redistribution remains NOT_READY and BLOCKED.

conditions.required: Run separately authorized install, discovery, restart, real Nova invocation, and rollback journeys on disposable Codex and Claude-compatible hosts.
conditions.status_until_satisfied: No installed, discoverable, invoked, or healthy host claim is supported.

conditions.required: Before any hosted dispatch, obtain an authoritative capacity snapshot for the exact billing scope, refresh boundary, principal-set reserve, and required authority. Preserve the complete 60 raw-runner-minute plan and publication distinction.
conditions.status_until_satisfied: GitHub-hosted and cross-platform claims remain unproved; decision stays HOLD_UNKNOWN; zero hosted runs.

conditions.required: Preserve Hesperos conditions and run representative specialist behavior qualification before making formal accessibility, representative-user, comprehensive responsive, or all-skill efficacy claims.
conditions.status_until_satisfied: Local qualification remains limited to the exercised static and Windows evidence boundary.

residual_risks: Host-specific installation and invocation defects may remain.
GitHub runner, matrix, permissions, artifacts, Pages, and status integration remain unproved.
Formal accessibility, representative-user, broader browser/zoom, and specialist-efficacy claims remain unsupported.
reopen_triggers: Any product, test, workflow, build, package, artifact, rights, documentation, or source-lock change.
Any attempt to change candidate state, public status, or publication authority.
Any new host or provider evidence used to broaden the claim.
evidence_boundary: Independent review supports the operator NOT_READY verdict and a bounded local static qualification for the exact repaired checkpoint and frozen archive hashes. It does not establish fresh-host installation, discovery, invocation, hosted CI, formal accessibility conformance, representative-user outcomes, all-skill efficacy, redistribution authority, publication, or a sealed release.
